text:
Dmitri: Heads-up — planning a short rolling deploy for inference-routes service (v2) tonight at 22:00 UTC. Please ack who can own smoke and rollback readiness.

Dmitri: Quick preflight checklist: 
- window: 22:00-22:30 UTC
- blackout: none
- smoke owners: (need 2)
- rollback owner: (one person)
- no DB migrations, just model config + routing rules
- runbook: /runbooks/inference/rollback.md

Dmitri: Commands we'll use:
```
# kick the canary rollout
redwoodctl deploy inference-routes --image=inference:v2 --strategy=rolling --canary=10%\n
# quick rollback if needed
redwoodctl rollback inference-routes --to=previous
```

Alice: I can own smoke for the backend and perf traces. Will be online at 21:50 UTC. :+1:

Ben: I can run the end-to-end user flows and watch latency SLOs + error budget dashboards. If I see >1% 5xx or p50 spike >200ms i'll call rollback.

Carla: Quick Q — is any config push touching routing rules that could impact dedicated customers? Need to ensure weights aren't swapped for the dedicated lane.

Dmitri: Good call. No changes to dedicated routing. It's just label-based selector for v2; dedicated lanes are pinned.

Carla: ok ack, will spot-check dedicated lane metrics at +5m.

Eva: I'm oncall during the window and will take rollback if there's a major outage. I'll also run follow-up smoke at +15m.

Dmitri: Assigning roles then: 
- smoke owners: Alice, Ben
- rollback owner: Eva
- deploy lead: Dmitri

Dmitri: Minimal smoke script (running locally on smoke VM):
```
./smoke-check.sh --route inference-routes --concurrency 5 --requests 50
```

Ben: I'll also watch the tracing tag `deploy:inference-v2` and the `token-cost` metric to ensure no cost regression.

deploy-bot: Deployment job created: job-87234, queued by Dmitri. Trigger: inference-routes:v2.

Dmitri: Running final preflight now: health checks + canary config validated.

deploy-bot: job-87234 started (canary 10%).

Alice: Canary smoke running — basic flows ok, no increase in 5xx in canary group. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary completed. health_ok=true, error_rate=0.0%, latency_p50=63ms. Proceeding to 50%.

Ben: Rolling to 50% — running e2e. Quick logs from smoke script:
```
[smoke] 2026-02-14T22:01:12Z request=1 status=200 latency=58ms
[smoke] 2026-02-14T22:01:20Z request=50 status=200 latency=72ms
[smoke] summary: 50/50 OK, p50=65ms, p95=110ms
```

Carla: Dedicated lane metrics unchanged. No traffic bleed.

deploy-bot: job-87234 completed successfully. rollout=100%, duration=7m.

Dmitri: Post-deploy checks: 
- dashboard alerts: none
- spot-check requests: ok
- canary/rollback logs archived to s3://redwood-deploy-logs/job-87234

Eva: Verified, everything looks green at +15m. I'll hold monitoring for another 45m.

Alice: :thumbsup: closing smoke checklist.

Ben: ACK, all good on my side.

Dmitri: Thanks everyone — leaving the follow-up monitoring to Eva. If anything pops up ping #incidents.

Carla: Nice and smooth. Thanks team. :party_popper:
